react_result.final_narrative_text: The treatment group exhibits a coordinated perturbation of the arachidonic acid cascade and the connected sulphur amino-acid trans-sulfuration pathway. Across three independent enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR = 6.2×10⁻¹⁴), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 2.5×10⁻⁶), and Mummichog m/z-network analysis (p = 0.002) — the top-scoring pathway is arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590), also known as Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) in the WikiPathways namespace. Six of the eight input metabolites map directly into this pathway: arachidonic acid (C00219, ChEBI:15843) as the canonical upstream substrate; leukotriene A4 (C00909, ChEBI:15651) as the 5-lipoxygenase product; 5-HETE (C04805, ChEBI:28209) as the hydroperoxide intermediate; and the three downstream eicosanoid signals 15-HETE (C04742, ChEBI:15558), 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ2 (C14717, ChEBI:34159), spanning the 5-LOX, 15-LOX, and COX/PGS branches respectively. The methionine/cysteine trans-sulfuration axis (L-cysteine C00097; L-cystathionine C02291) anchors a secondary axis: cystathionine is the direct trans-sulfuration node linking homocysteine to cysteine, and L-cysteine is the substrate for GSH synthesis and for the 5-lipoxygenase activating protein (FLAP) cofactor pool. Mercaptopurine (C02380, ChEBI:2208) — a structural purine analogue — does not appear in the arachidonic acid network, indicating it is a treatment-specific off-target rather than a pathway driver. The convergent three-paradigm signal across the eicosanoid axis is biologically coherent: arachidonic acid is the metabolic gate from which 5-HETE (via 5-LOX), leukotriene A4 (via LTA₄ synthase), 15-HETE (via 15-LOX), and 15-deoxy-PGJ2 (via COX/PGD₂ dehydration) branch, consistent with a perturbed oxidative-inflammatory or resolution phenotype in the treatment condition.

  "narrative_text": "The treatment group exhibits a coordinated perturbation of the arachidonic acid cascade and the connected sulphur amino-acid trans-sulfuration pathway. Across three independent enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR = 6.2×10⁻¹⁴), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 2.5×10⁻⁶), and Mummichog m/z-network analysis (p = 0.002) — the top-scoring pathway is arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590), also known as Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) in the WikiPathways namespace. Six of the eight input metabolites map directly into this pathway: arachidonic acid (C00219, ChEBI:15843) as the canonical upstream substrate; leukotriene A4 (C00909, ChEBI:15651) as the 5-lipoxygenase product; 5-HETE (C04805, ChEBI:28209) as the hydroperoxide intermediate; and the three downstream eicosanoid signals 15-HETE (C04742, ChEBI:15558), 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ2 (C14717, ChEBI:34159), spanning the 5-LOX, 15-LOX, and COX/PGS branches respectively. final_react_result.final_narrative_text: The treatment group exhibits a coordinated perturbation of the arachidonic acid cascade and the connected sulphur amino-acid trans-sulfuration pathway. Across three independent enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR = 6.2×10⁻¹⁴), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 2.5×10⁻⁶), and Mummichog m/z-network analysis (p = 0.002) — the top-scoring pathway is arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590), also known as Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) in the WikiPathways namespace. Six of the eight input metabolites map directly into this pathway: arachidonic acid (C00219, ChEBI:15843) as the canonical upstream substrate; leukotriene A4 (C00909, ChEBI:15651) as the 5-lipoxygenase product; 5-HETE (C04805, ChEBI:28209) as the hydroperoxide intermediate; and the three downstream eicosanoid signals 15-HETE (C04742, ChEBI:15558), 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ2 (C14717, ChEBI:34159), spanning the 5-LOX, 15-LOX, and COX/PGS branches respectively. The methionine/cysteine trans-sulfuration axis (L-cysteine C00097; L-cystathionine C02291) anchors a secondary axis: cystathionine is the direct trans-sulfuration node linking homocysteine to cysteine, and L-cysteine is the substrate for GSH synthesis and for the 5-lipoxygenase activating protein (FLAP) cofactor pool. Mercaptopurine (C02380, ChEBI:2208) — a structural purine analogue — does not appear in the arachidonic acid network, indicating it is a treatment-specific off-target rather than a pathway driver. The convergent three-paradigm signal across the eicosanoid axis is biologically coherent: arachidonic acid is the metabolic gate from which 5-HETE (via 5-LOX), leukotriene A4 (via LTA₄ synthase), 15-HETE (via 15-LOX), and 15-deoxy-PGJ2 (via COX/PGD₂ dehydration) branch, consistent with a perturbed oxidative-inflammatory or resolution phenotype in the treatment condition.
